correctness.rationale: PASS: G_n is the additive space of alternating n-by-n matrices even in characteristic two. For coordinate additive character gamma_B, the step E(u,v)=uv^T-vu^T pairs exactly as u^TBv, and averaging over uniform v leaves probability u in ker B=q^{-rank B}. Alternating rank=2r, with multiplicity [n choose 2r]_q |GL_{2r}|/|Sp_{2r}|; Parseval yields the chi-square formula for all t>=0. Factoring the multiplicity and using a uniform q^{-quadratic in r} bound gives both even and odd s-offset limiting chi-square series. For t=floor(n/2)+a_n the sum goes to zero, while for t=floor(n/2)-a_n rank at most 2t forces nullity>=2a_n and the uniform-random nullity union bound tends to zero. Independent GF(2) enumeration found n=3 rank counts {0:1,2:7} and n=4 counts {0:1,2:35,4:28}, and directly verified Fourier expectation 2^{-rank B} for every character through n=4. Tests do not establish asymptotic TV cutoff alone.
